messages:
maria.k: FYI CVE-2026-0421 (grpcx deserialization) just landed in the OSS advisory. Affects grpcx <= 1.4.2. We need a plan to backport to Dedicated and Private images (customer-specific images + VPC/on-prem constraints).
jon.r: I have a patch on main that fixes it, small change in message parsing. Backport should be trivial code-wise, but the problem is our private distro uses base-image v1.12 which has older deps.
sara.t: Are there any RBAC or KMS implications? Private customers often rely on their KMS/HSM workflow for image signing and key rotation.
maria.k: Good call. Also need audit logging entries for the patch rollout and CVE reference for compliance.
kevin.p: Build-wise: we can create a hotpatch image branch per affected customer or a single backport branch that reuses their pinned base. Customers A and B are on pinned images; C is on our default, so easier.
jon.r: I worry about churn if we create per-customer branches. Suggest: create a backport branch off 1.12-base, apply the CVE patch, run minimal regression tests, then produce a signed image that we can tag for customers needing the pin.
sara.t: For on-prem installs we can't push images into their clusters. We provide a signed tarball + image manifest and a signed provenance file. Need to confirm our signing uses the customer's KMS or our signing key. Some customers require BYOK signing with their HSM.
maria.k: Action item: list customers who require BYOK/HSM signing. If they do, we'll need a short runbook to instruct local image import and verification. Also audit logs must show who requested the patch and when, with CVE id.
kevin.p: I'll add a small change to the build pipeline to emit SBOM + CVE metadata into the artifact storage. That helps compliance and audit teams.
jon.r: Quick technical note: backport diff is this single hunk in parser.go. Could do cherry-pick. Tests: unit + integration (grpc fuzzer) should be run.
kevin.p: CI will run unit and integration; for onprem images we need a separate job to build with older base-image and run smoke tests within a VM that mirrors customer OS.
sec-oncall: tagging priority: This CVE is CVSS 7.8, exploit published in the wild. Recommend P1 for Dedicated, P1 for Private with high-exposure customers.
maria.k: OK P1. Who can own the backport + image build? Need ETA and minimal rollback plan.
jon.r: I can own the backport patch and test. ETA: 24-36 hours to produce backport branch and artifacts.
sara.t: I'll coordinate KMS/signing and compliance audit entries. Need to know which customers require BYOK.
kevin.p: I'll wire the pipeline. ETA 36 hours to add the backport job, plus another 12 for signing automation.
maria.k: Rollout plan proposal: 1) Create backport branch + build signed image 2) Run smoke + fuzzer tests 3) Create provenance + SBOM artifacts 4) Notify customers + deliver signed tarball or push to their registry as agreed 5) Monitor audit logs and errors for 72h 6) If issues, rollback by retagging previous signed image and notify customers.
jon.r: One more: update our fallback routing so that if Dedicated pool can't accept the new image for any reason we serve token-limited fallback model (not affected by grpcx change) to reduce exposure. Ops has that policy available.
kevin.p: Example commands for customers importing signed image locally:
```
# load image tarball
sudo ctr -n k8s.io images import redwood-grpcx-fix_1.12.tar
# verify signature
cosign verify-blob --key <customer-kms-public> redwood-grpcx-fix_1.12.tar.sig redwood-grpcx-fix_1.12.tar
```
sara.t: I'll draft a short customer-facing note with required steps and the CVE info.
deploy-bot: build 1805001248 backport-1.12-image: SUCCESS (sha256:abc123)
maria.k: Nice. kevin, jon — once you have artifacts, ping me and I'll open the customer deliveries and update the incident tracker. Sec-oncall, can you update the advisory to P1 and list mitigations?
sec-oncall: Done. Advisory updated, mitigation guidance added (disable grpcx server-side parsing of unknown fields, deploy hotpatch).
jon.r: Any objections to creating a short-lived customer-specific image branch named hotpatch/cve-2026-0421-1.12? I'll keep it alive for 30 days then merge into next LTS if no regressions.
sara.t: OK as long as we document the branching policy and retention. Compliance needs the timeline for retention and provenance.
maria.k: Sounds good. I'll create a Jira epic and assign tasks: BACKPORT-121 (jon), PIPELINE-432 (kevin), COMMS-88 (sara). Target: ship signed artifacts to customers within 48h.
kevin.p: I'll start the pipeline work now.
jon.r: Starting cherry-pick + tests.
maria.k: Thanks team. Keep updates here, please. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: smoke-test 1805001290 hotpatch-1.12: PASS
kevin.p: artifact + SBOM uploaded to artifacts.redwood.internal/storage/backports/cve-2026-0421/sha256:abc123
maria.k: Closing loop — created epic and linked customers. Will post follow-ups after deliveries.
